checks.question: What is the role of the nyatiti in Luo musical heritage? Keep it brief.
checks.answer: The nyatiti is an eight-stringed lyre central to Luo music, especially among the Luo of western Kenya. A player (often called a nyatiti player or jathum) sits with the instrument resting against the chest or lap, plucking the strings while a metal ring on the toe of one foot strikes a rattle on the lower frame to mark the beat. It accompanies praise songs, satirical and storytelling songs, and dance, and virtuoso players were and are celebrated performers whose songs carry social commentary and history. Styles and tuning vary between regions and individuals, so descriptions differ. Documented recordings of Luo music and performance exist in the collection [Source 2], though that reference is a general theme listing and gives no specific detail about the nyatiti.
checks.translation: Nyatiti en thum ma nigi nyithind thum ariyo (nyatiti) ma en gir tij mana mar jog Luo, to moloyo joluo ma nogweng'e Kenya. Ng'at ma goyo (ma iluongo ni jathum) bedo ka girno opon e kor some kata e kore, kago thunde ka gaso, ka nyithind badi mag lwedo achiel goyo nyieke e badi ma piny mondo oket migawo mar weche. Goyo nyatiti nyalo lendo wer mag pak, wer mag ng'awono kod sigana, kod miel; joma goyo nyatiti ma ong'eny ne en joma yaye ma wende-gi kel weche mag piny kod historia. Kit goye kod lung'one opogore e kind gwenge kod ji mopogore, omiyo lwedo ok chal. Nende mag goyo nyatiti gi miel mar Luo nitie e kuseb [Source 2], kata kamano ndikno en mana orund mar weche ma ok nyis gik mokwongo kuom nyatiti.

checks.question: Nyatiti en ang'o?
checks.answer: Nyatiti en nyatonge mar thum ma jiwo gi thund'e, ma okalo e kin Luo machalo gi nyithindo koda jodongo e piny Luo machalo gi Kenya. Oywaye gi yie gedo mayot, kendo en achiel kuom nyatonge mawuoyo e sigendini mag Luo. Koro ok an gi riwruok mokwongo e migawo mar ikruok kuom nyatiti, omiyo ok anyalo wacho ni kama opon e ot ikruok mar piny.[Source 1][Source 4][Source 5]
checks.translation: The nyatiti is a traditional Luo stringed instrument, a lyre with strings and a resonator, played in Luo communities, including those in Kenya. It is made with a wooden frame and skin, and it is one of the instruments central to Luo music and oral performance. I do not have a verified library record specifically for the nyatiti here, so I cannot confirm its presence in the platform collection.[Source 1][Source 4][Source 5]
